text:
maria: quick heads-up — i sketched a recompute-selector API for telemetry backfills. goal: a single filter language the console/cli can use + an early cost estimate + dry-run. want design input :eyes:

ajay: love this. one big Q: enforce quotas at the API (reject upfront) or let scheduler enforce (accept and queue)?

kevin: +1 for API-level reject. saves ops churn. also API should return estimated_tokens and an estimated_duration for display.

liz: UX idea: preview pane shows first 500 keys + a sampled diff summary. add a "sample" toggle in console. dry-run should include histogram of metric deltas.

maria: early proto payload I put together:
```json
POST /v1/recompute/selector
{
  "filter": "env:prod AND metric_namespace:agg_hours AND dt >= 2026-03-01",
  "canary_percent": 5,
  "quota_mode": "check-only", // consume | reserve | check-only
  "dry_run": true,
  "return_preview": 500
}
```

carmen: tenant isolation: tenants with reserved capacity should get "reserve" semantics so shared pool isn't charged. need clear error codes when estimate would blow tenant commit.

ajay: agree. add explicit quota_mode field. default to check-only to avoid surprising charges. api should return a recommended stagger plan when estimate > allowed.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: recompute-selector-v0 -> staging @ 2026-03-12T18:00Z :package:

kevin: routing note: backfills should prefer Dedicated -> Hosted -> fallback to compatible model variants in the same region. expose routing_hint on the API so console can show expected latency/cost tradeoffs.

liz: tiny UX nit: mark the preview rows with reason why they were included (match clause) and show sample hash so can reproduce. also surface a "risk" badge if sample diff > 10%.

maria: add plan id in response so ops and console can reference the run: {"plan_id": "str"}. also suggest we return a small cost-breakdown: {"estimate": {"tokens": 12345, "gpu_hours": "0.4"}}

ajay: and include a preview_hash in response so "replay with same sample" is possible. nice for canary-to-full rollouts.

carmen: audit/logging: every selector.create and selector.execute should emit an audit event with plan_id, who ran it, quota_mode, and the estimate. saves us from chasing tickets later.

kevin: for quota enforcement, propose a soft-fail path: if estimate > quota and quota_mode=="consume" -> return 409 with a payload that includes a suggested stagger windows array and an "apply_recommendation" link.

maria: i can mock the recommended windows algo — it should look at slot availability and return chunks like [{"start":"2026-03-13T00:00Z","end":"2026-03-13T06:00Z","slots":2}]

ops-bot: FYI infra: the scheduler currently supports slot reservations and preemption; we'll need an API to accept the recommended windows as reservations to guarantee the plan.

liz: console: show a cost slider + estimated time to complete. add a "preview diff" modal and a "safety gates" checkbox (require QA signoff if risk > threshold).

kevin: we should also surface an approximation of downstream query impact (eg: extra db reads) in the cost-breakdown. ops cares about IOPS spike.

ajay: i'll own the api contract PR. let's include these fields: quota_mode, canary_percent, return_preview, preview_hash, estimated_tokens, estimated_gpu_hours, routing_hint, plan_id.

maria: perfect. want to sync tomorrow 10am to align console mocks + api contract. ping me if you want to add anything before then. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for recompute-selector-v0 -> canary-1 :rocket:
